channel.title: The Handy Fix
channel.description: Clear, step-by-step guides for cleaning, cooking, laundry, storage, small repairs and saving money at home, written and checked by real people.

item.title: Best Fridge and Freezer Settings to Save Energy
item.description: Set your fridge to 40°F (4°C) or below and your freezer to 0°F (-18°C), then use a few easy habits to cut wasted energy without putting food safety at risk.

item.title: How to Fix a Running Toilet: Find the Cause First
item.description: A toilet that keeps running wastes water around the clock. Use a simple dye test to find the cause, then fix the flapper, chain, float or fill valve yourself.

item.title: How to Clean a Microwave With Lemon or Vinegar Steam
item.description: Loosen baked-on splatters in minutes with a bowl of water and lemon or vinegar, then wipe them away. No harsh chemicals or hard scrubbing needed.
